environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic directly to the container on port 3000. No request body inspection or filtering is performed at any layer. The service uses TypeORM with PostgreSQL RDS and the entity schema includes sensitive privilege columns (role, isAdmin, creditLimit).

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF WebACL associated
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.body_parsing: NestJS default JSON body parser, no size limit override
